goal: Take this vlog I uploaded, figure out the right BGM style based on what's happening on screen, add that music, and burn in English subtitles from the speech
rationale: User wants enhanced version of existing vlog with content-matched BGM + burned subtitles. Transcribe speech, analyze video to inform music style, compose BGM, mix, composite with subtitles.

plan.intent: Ingest the uploaded vlog as the source video for enhancement.
Transcribe the speech in the vlog into time-aligned English subtitle cues.
Analyze the vlog's content, tone, and pacing so music style can be matched to what's actually happening on screen.
Compose a BGM track whose style matches the video-analysis tone report, matched in length to the vlog.
Mix the BGM under the vlog's original audio so the speech stays clearly audible.
Composite the video with the mixed audio, burn the English subtitles, and output the enhanced vlog.
